CHIEF DESIGN REVIEW — AMEND exact a51df16 / docs/design/candidate-nomination-provenance-court.md before authorization. The core finite-before-sort, typed coordinates, derived identities, retained bundle, wire migration, and four-door construction court are correct. Four load-bearing source paths remain outside the court:

1. candidates.scala:124 discards every SemanticDistance Left via toOption, not only non-finite Double. The contract must retain a typed per-attempt outcome for valid finite score, provider abstention/missing evidence, invalid non-finite result, and provider/derivation failure. Otherwise "never nominated" still conflates failure classes after this repair.

2. CandidateSet.of at :45-52 is a public convenience bypass that mints arbitrary anchors under "unspecified" with no authority. CandidateSet and Candidates are public case classes, and abstained is caller-selected. Section 8 names HsmmResult/AlignWire/codec but not these construction roots. The migration must remove/close the plain-anchor bypass or require an explicit admitted external/manual authority receipt; make the checked bundle itself unforgeable and derive abstention from its attempt ledger.

3. CandidateSet.without at :38-40 relabels an empty result after ablation as abstained. That is not provider abstention: it is a counterfactual empty-after-channel-removal. Preserve original availability and record the ablation policy/outcome separately so Unranked cannot turn an experimental ablation into an alleged aligner/provider failure.

4. The published anchor set and ranks must be derived, not parallel caller fields. Section 5 says the bundle binds ordered nominations plus the resulting anchor set, but does not say the factory computes anchors/ranks from the admitted pre-take ledger. Add mutations that alter an anchor or rank while holding attempts/scores fixed. Include the full pre-take evaluated universe/outcomes (or a content-addressed complete trace), explicit per-level/channel budgets, deterministic local lexical derivation receipt, and the RRF policy/k/input-channel bundle; retaining only winners cannot audit why a node lost selection.

Required successor stays one docs path/no API. Add the omitted live lines (:38-52, :59-69, :124) to the source checklist and named mutations. Resolve, rather than leave open, rank scope/nonnegativity and lexical receipt: ranks are derived under a declared ordering; deterministic lexical work still gets a local derivation receipt even though it makes no provider call. No implementation/authorization yet.
